code: bool const is_ftyp = (buf[4] == 'f' && buf[5] == 't' && buf[6] == 'y' && buf[7] == 'p');
note: The candidate begins with an ftyp box, so it is accepted as BMFF input.
Metadata parsing iterates through top-level BMFF boxes until the brob box is handled.
The brob box uses length zero, making the box extend to the end of file.
The brob payload is read into a DataBuf whose first four bytes are interpreted as the embedded real type.
Bytes after the brob realType field are passed directly as the Brotli compressed stream.

code: size_t uncompressedLen = compressedBufSize * 2;  // just a starting point
note: The initial output allocation is derived only from attacker-controlled compressedBufSize and can exceed the later 128 KiB cap before the cap is applied.
DataBuf::alloc resizes the backing std::vector and may move the output storage across decompression iterations.
The output pointer supplied to Brotli is computed from total_out and the current DataBuf allocation.
Brotli writes decompressed bytes through next_out using the available_out value prepared by Exiv2.
